claims.summary: The dataset and promotion systems refuse unsafe learning: 0 of 471 raw events are eligible, groups cannot cross splits, and candidate or promoted manifests require the frozen corpus and external-evidence gates.

Applied-depth and repair changes cut exact-Qwen Scion calls from 108 to 91. The final Business Ethics browser package is 99/A with zero findings and its 1.247x burden versus exact Gemma passes the 1.25x ceiling.
The release explicitly separates the compiler-only hosted route, shared model-neutral compiler gains, and future Gemma-specific adapter learning. No new weights or browser adapter are claimed.
